newsitem.title: USA: Texas Utilities power plant resumes output.
newsitem.headline: Texas Utilities power plant resumes output.

text.p: Texas Utilities Co's 1,150 megawatt Comanche Peak nuclear power unit 1 resumed production over the weekend, returning from a scheduled outage, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The Glen Rose, Texas unit was operating at 28 percent of capacity and holding power at that level for restart tests as of early Monday morning, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
Comanche Peak 1 was shut Oct 5 for scheduled refueling and maintenance.
The 1,150 megawatt Comanche Peak nuclear power unit 2, at the same Glen Rose site, was operating normally at 100 percent production as of early Monday, the NRC said.
